summary: Retractable Technologies filed an 8-K announcing a dividend declaration on its Series II and Series III Class B Convertible Preferred Stock. The aggregate dividends amount to $57,611.25 ($39,050.00 + $18,561.25), accruing at $1.00 per share per annum for the period April 1, 2026 to June 30, 2026. The payment date is July 20, 2026 to holders of record on July 10, 2026. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The filing is a routine dividend declaration, not a transformative capital return event. What to watch: no risk-arb angle; monitoring recurring preferred dividend coverage is key.
